description.narrative: Søholm 4H and the Rural Enterprise Trust of Zimbabwe (RETZ) intends to conduct a Preparatory Study to design and prepare a future Pilot Project together in the fields that are relevant for both organizations’ work. The aim of the Pilot Project is to create youth-led activities for young people (15-35) living in rural communities that promote cooperation and active participation. And the main objectives are: •to visit and explore the identified common project ideas for the future pilot project; • to analyze the needs for the future project and prepare a timetable for the Pilot Project; •to co-develop the application documents for the Pilot Project. Through the Preparatory Study, the partner organizations will learn more about each other, share best practices and co-develop pilot project documents for submission after the study. It will involve 3 delegates from RETZ in Zimbabwe visiting Danish 4H in Denmark for a 5 day project including 2 travel days.
